parsed.lessons_learned: Always check tokens_owed on ALL LP positions every single cycle - had 0.97 ETH + 8,273 USDT sitting uncollected in 49c983e5 for potentially multiple cycles. That's a significant oversight. With 0 liquidity in the position but tokens_owed > 0, the fees were from when the position had active liquidity. The v3_collect_fees action doesn't require active liquidity - it just claims accumulated fees. Never let tokens_owed accumulate without collecting.
